recipe.criteria: Plate-loaded kneeling leg curl: left knee/shin and both elbows supported, right thigh on front pad and knee aligned with side lever pivot. Right leg curls from 180 to 80 degrees against a roller above the ankle. Four seconds curl and four seconds return; switch sides between sets. Generic apparatus, not a dimensional replica.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
